verses.en: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.
verses.pt: Portanto, se fostes ressuscitados com Cristo, buscai as coisas de cima, onde Cristo está sentado à direita de Deus.
verses.en_web: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.
verses.en_bbe: If then you have a new life with Christ, give your attention to the things of heaven, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.

verses.en: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.
verses.pt: Pensai nas coisas de cima, não nas que estão na terra.
verses.en_web: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.
verses.en_bbe: Keep your mind on the higher things, not on the things of earth.

verses.en: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.
verses.pt: Pois já morrestes, e a vossa vida está escondida com Cristo em Deus.
verses.en_web: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.
verses.en_bbe: For your life on earth is done, and you have a secret life with Christ in God.

verses.en: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.
verses.pt: Quando Cristo, que é a nossa vida, se manifestar, então também vós vos manifestareis com ele em glória.
verses.en_web: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.
verses.en_bbe: At the coming of Christ who is our life, you will be seen with him in glory.

verses.en: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:
verses.pt: Portanto, mortificai as partes carnais que há em vós que são terrenas; são elas: o pecado sexual, a impureza, a paixão depravada, o desejo maligno, e a ganância, que é idolatria.
verses.en_web: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry;
verses.en_bbe: Then put to death your bodies which are of the earth; wrong use of the flesh, unclean things, passion, evil desires and envy, which is the worship of strange gods;

verses.en: For which things’ sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:
verses.pt: Por causa delas que a ira de Deus vem sobre os filhos da desobediência.
verses.en_web: for which things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
verses.en_bbe: Because of which the wrath of God comes on those who go against his orders;

verses.en: In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.
verses.pt: Nessas coisas também vós andastes antes, quando vivíeis nelas.
verses.en_web: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them;
verses.en_bbe: Among whom you were living in the past, when you did such things.

verses.en: But now ye also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth.
verses.pt: Mas agora, abandonai, vós também, todas estas coisas: a ira, a fúria, a malícia, a maledicência, e as palavras vergonhosas da vossa boca.
verses.en_web: but now you also put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.
verses.en_bbe: But now it is right for you to put away all these things; wrath, passion, bad feeling, curses, unclean talk;

verses.en: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;
verses.pt: Não mintais uns aos outros, pois já vos despistes do velho ser humano com os seus costumes,
verses.en_web: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,
verses.en_bbe: Do not make false statements to one another; because you have put away the old man with all his doings,

verses.en: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:
verses.pt: e vos revestistes do novo, que se renova em conhecimento, conforme a imagem daquele que o criou.
verses.en_web: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,
verses.en_bbe: And have put on the new man, which has become new in knowledge after the image of his maker;

verses.en: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.
verses.pt: Nisso não há grego, nem judeu, nem circunciso, nem incircunciso, bárbaro, cita, escravo, nem livre; mas Cristo é tudo, e em todos.
verses.en_web: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, freeman; but Christ is all, and in all.
verses.en_bbe: Where there is no Greek or Jew, no one with circumcision or without circumcision, no division between nations, no servant or free man: but Christ is all and in all.

verses.en: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;
verses.pt: Por isso, como escolhidos de Deus, santos e amados, revesti-vos de sentimentos de misericórdia, bondade, humildade, mansidão, e paciência.
verses.en_web: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;
verses.en_bbe: As saints of God, then, holy and dearly loved, let your behaviour be marked by pity and mercy, kind feeling, a low opinion of yourselves, gentle ways, and a power of undergoing all things;

verses.en: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.
verses.pt: Suportai-vos uns aos outros, e perdoai-vos uns aos outros, se alguém tiver queixa contra outro. Como Cristo vos perdoou, assim também fazei.
verses.en_web: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.
verses.en_bbe: Being gentle to one another and having forgiveness for one another, if anyone has done wrong to his brother, even as the Lord had forgiveness for you:

verses.en: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.
verses.pt: E acima de tudo isto, revesti-vos do amor, que é o vínculo da perfeição.
verses.en_web: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.
verses.en_bbe: And more than all, have love; the only way in which you may be completely joined together.

verses.en: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.
verses.pt: E a paz de Deus, para a qual também fostes chamados em um só corpo, governe em vossos corações, e sede gratos.
verses.en_web: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body; and be thankful.
verses.en_bbe: And let the peace of Christ be ruling in your hearts, as it was the purpose of God for you to be one body; and give praise to God at all times.

verses.en: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.
verses.pt: A palavra de Cristo habite abundantemente em vós com toda sabedoria, ensinando-vos e advertindo-vos uns aos outros; e cantai ao Senhor com salmos, hinos, e cânticos espirituais, com graça no vosso coração.
verses.en_web: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: Let the word of Christ be in you in all wealth of wisdom; teaching and helping one another with songs of praise and holy words, making melody to God with grace in your hearts.

verses.en: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.
verses.pt: E tudo quanto fizerdes, por palavras ou por obras, fazei tudo no nome do Senhor Jesus, dando por meio dele graças ao Deus e Pai.
verses.en_web: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father, through him.
verses.en_bbe: And whatever you do, in word or in act, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving praise to God the Father through him.

verses.en: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.
verses.pt: Mulheres, sede submissas aos vossos próprios maridos, como convém no Senhor.
verses.en_web: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: Wives, be under the authority of your husbands, as is right in the Lord.

verses.en: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.
verses.pt: Maridos, amai às esposas, e não as trateis amargamente.
verses.en_web: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.
verses.en_bbe: Husbands, have love for your wives, and be not bitter against them.

verses.en: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.
verses.pt: Filhos, obedecei em tudo aos pais, porque isso é agradável ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.
verses.en_bbe: Children, do the orders of your fathers and mothers in all things, for this is pleasing to the Lord.

verses.en: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.
verses.pt: Pais, não provoqueis aos vossos filhos, para que não percam o ânimo.
verses.en_web: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.
verses.en_bbe: Fathers, do not be hard on your children, so that their spirit may not be broken.

verses.en: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:
verses.pt: Escravos, obedecei em tudo aos vossos senhores segundo a carne, não servindo apenas quando observados, como que para satisfazer às pessoas, mas sim, com sinceridade de coração, temendo a Deus.
verses.en_web: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.
verses.en_bbe: Servants, in all things do the orders of your natural masters; not only when their eyes are on you, as pleasers of men, but with all your heart, fearing the Lord:

verses.en: And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men;
verses.pt: E tudo quanto fizerdes, fazei de coração, como para o Senhor, e não para as pessoas.
verses.en_web: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord, and not for men,
verses.en_bbe: Whatever you do, do it readily, as to the Lord and not to men;

verses.en: Knowing that of the Lord ye shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for ye serve the Lord Christ.
verses.pt: Pois sabeis que recebereis do Senhor a recompensa da herança, porque servis ao Senhor Cristo.
verses.en_web: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.
verses.en_bbe: Being certain that the Lord will give you the reward of the heritage: for you are the servants of the Lord Christ.

verses.en: But he that doeth wrong shall receive for the wrong which he hath done: and there is no respect of persons.
verses.pt: Mas aquele que fizer injustiça receberá conforme a injustiça que cometer; e não há acepção de pessoas.
verses.en_web: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.
verses.en_bbe: For the wrongdoer will have punishment for the wrong he has done, without respect for any man's position.
